note: SAE J2012 powertrain codes that Magneti Marelli IAW ECUs actually raise on Moto Guzzi twins, plus the Marelli-specific interpretations where they differ from the generic text.

codes.P0030: Lambda heater control circuit, bank 1 sensor 1
codes.P0036: Lambda heater control circuit, bank 2 sensor 1
codes.P0107: Manifold absolute pressure sensor circuit low
codes.P0108: Manifold absolute pressure sensor circuit high
codes.P0112: Intake air temperature sensor circuit low
codes.P0113: Intake air temperature sensor circuit high
codes.P0122: Throttle position sensor circuit low - check the TPS and its reference voltage
codes.P0123: Throttle position sensor circuit high - check the TPS and its reference voltage
codes.P0131: Lambda sensor circuit low voltage, bank 1 - lean or sensor failure
codes.P0132: Lambda sensor circuit high voltage, bank 1 - rich or sensor failure
codes.P0134: Lambda sensor no activity, bank 1 - common after an exhaust change
codes.P0137: Lambda sensor circuit low voltage, bank 2
codes.P0138: Lambda sensor circuit high voltage, bank 2
codes.P0170: Fuel trim fault, bank 1 - adaptation at its limit
codes.P0173: Fuel trim fault, bank 2 - adaptation at its limit
codes.P0335: Crankshaft position sensor circuit - the bike will not start if this is current
codes.P0336: Crankshaft position sensor range or performance
codes.P0351: Ignition coil A primary/secondary - front cylinder
codes.P0352: Ignition coil B primary/secondary - rear cylinder
codes.P0505: Idle control system - stepper or air leak
codes.P0507: Idle speed above target - check for an air leak
codes.P0562: System voltage low - charging or battery fault
codes.P1500: Marelli: side stand or kill switch input
codes.U0155: Lost communication with the instrument cluster
